trials.name: the capacity comparison accepts a ceiling that merely EXCEEDS the profile
a nonsensical expected capacity is accepted instead of refused
free BYTES are ignored, so only the inode reserve is enforced
free INODES are ignored, so only the byte reserve is enforced
the headroom verdict is gathered and then not acted on
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH admits a second beyond the supported range
seconds reach the builders as seconds, not milliseconds

_comment: These three functions are the image builders' product contract -- the encoded growth ceiling a profile requires, the free bytes AND free inodes a shipped image must still have, and the reproducible timestamp every build derives from SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH. Four or more builder scripts call each, and until 2026-09-16 all of them were tested only inside `vfs-image.test.ts`, which step 5 deletes along with a filesystem none of them use. The claims moved to this module's own test file; these trials are what says the move kept them. The two headroom trials are separated deliberately: SharedFS accounts for blocks and inodes independently, so a check that enforced either one alone would pass a test that only ever exhausted the other.
